description: Global Multiscale Road Network Patterns is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Chen. This is the outcome data of the paper "Global Urban Road Network Patterns". It contains the spatial data of grid cells of our cities of interests, with multiscale road network patterns. The grid cells are 1km-resolution (mid scale in this study) WorldPop grids. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3034301 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
